input.brief_text: Necesitamos dos archivos para Acme: PDF y JSON. Ambos deben contener la cadena exacta "Ready to ship". Plazo: 15 de noviembre. Presupuesto: 500 EUR. Se supone que los datos de origen ya se han proporcionado. Escribe este análisis en inglés.
input.deliverable_text: Solo se ha entregado el PDF para Acme con la cadena "Ready to ship". No se ha entregado el JSON. Se han respetado el plazo y el presupuesto.

criteria: Every authored canonical field follows the expected analysis language, including summaries and evidence explanations.
Quotations, brands, technical identifiers, source dates and amounts stay faithful; identifiers and enums are unchanged.
No invented facts, hidden findings, changed verdicts or unsupported readiness claims.
The explicit analysis-language request is honored and is not extracted as a project requirement.

document.summary: The work does not meet expectations because the required JSON file is missing. The first priority is to deliver the JSON file for Acme containing the exact string "Ready to ship"; the delivered PDF and reported compliance with the deadline and budget do not compensate for the missing deliverable.

sections.title: Verdict
sections.content:
The work does not meet expectations. This verdict is judged on the four general review criteria, not item by item on the acceptance criteria listed below.
Scope coverage is not satisfied: the brief requires PDF and JSON files for Acme, but the delivery states that only the PDF was delivered and the JSON was not delivered.
Requirement fit is not satisfied: both files must contain the exact string "Ready to ship", but only the PDF is confirmed to contain it because the required JSON is absent, although compliance with the deadline and budget is reported.
Completeness is not satisfied: of the two required deliverables, PDF and JSON, only the PDF is reported as delivered, and the delivery explicitly states that no JSON was delivered.
Clarity is satisfied: the delivery plainly identifies the delivered PDF containing "Ready to ship" and the missing JSON, and explicitly reports compliance with the deadline and budget.

sections.title: Acceptance criteria
sections.content:
- Two files are delivered for Acme: one PDF and one JSON.
- Both files contain the exact string "Ready to ship".
- The files are delivered by 15 de noviembre.
- The work stays within the budget of 500 EUR.
